original_case: Does a long unsuccessful wait change the remaining chance?
changed_condition: Now draw from a bag with one success token and three failures, without replacement.
viewer_inference: Removing failures changes the state. A model has no memory only when its assumptions make the past irrelevant to what remains.
resolution: Independent fixed-p Bernoulli trials have P(T>m+n|T>m)=(1−p)^n. Without replacement changes the next-success probability.
prerequisite: Operations introduced explicitly in this film
